title: I WILL sing of my Redeemer

lines.text: I WILL sing of my Redeemer
And his wondrous love to me
On the cruel cross he suffered
From the cross to set me free.
Sing, Oh sing of my Re-dee-mer
With his blood He purchase me!
On the cross
He sealed my pardon, paid the debt
And made me free.
I will tell the wonderous story,
How my lost estate to save
In the boundless love and mercy
He the ransom freely gave.
I will praise my dear redeemer
His triumphant power I‘ll tell;
How the victory He hath given
Over sin, and death, and hell.
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And his heavenly love to me;
He from death to life hath brought him
Son of God, with Him to be.
